## How it works

- [statement] Inter-token latency variance (jitter) is primarily induced by dynamic KV cache heap allocations and memory compaction pauses when context thresholds are crossed. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: TTFT Compute Bound Analysis and Inter-token Latency Jitter · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst

## Facts and statements

- [statement] TTFT scales with prompt length in proportion to compute matrix FLOPs (O(N)), while sequential token generation scales purely with memory bandwidth per token (O(1)). (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: TTFT Compute Bound Analysis and Inter-token Latency Jitter · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
